question: To which revilers must the sacred teaching never be given?
premises: Slandering the Kula Bhairava is a disqualification
The teaching must not be given to such persons
inference: The teaching must not be given to revilers of Shiva or slanderers of Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may refer to the tradition or deity
plain_english: O goddess, not to one who reviles Shiva, nor to a slanderer of the Kula Bhairava.
